name: Irimi Kaya
source:
Kaya Irimi (入見 カヤ, Irimi Kaya) is a ghoul and the former leader of the Black Dobers known by the alias Black Dog (黒狗, Kuroinu). She is a waitress working at Anteiku. 

She normally keeps to herself and is quiet and reserved. In subtle moments, she can be quite annoyed and speak out her honest thoughts however. She has also been shown to be especially kind towards Touka Kirishima, and Hinami Fueguchi. Like Enji Koma, she has been with Yoshimura long before they were employees at Anteiku and is quite loyal to the manager.

In the past, Irimi was a very murderous ghoul who possessed a more savage and cruel disposition. 

[From [url=http://tokyoghoul.wikia.com/wiki/Kaya_Irimi]Tokyo Ghoul Wikia[/url]]
